race.comment: GILGEOUS (3) has the standout exposed form after tackling the Listed Batman Handicap on Cup Day and the G2 Moonee Valley Vase at his past two runs. He was well beaten by Billycart last time after beginning awkwardly and covering ground, but this is a substantial drop in class and blinkers go on. FRANKIE'S PROMISE (10) is a Frankel filly on debut for the Price & Kent Jnr yard who has won a Cranbourne trial nicely. Kicks off at a good trip and should make her presence felt. ACTION POINT (1) has race fitness, first-time blinkers and a last-start Cranbourne second. Up to a mile looks ideal now he draws nicely. TAGGED (9) made sharp improvement second time out at Sale and should only improve up in trip again. He'll take some holding out. SOUTHPOLE (8) was no match for a dominant winner on debut but ran well and can figure.
